div.div: حُكْلَةٌ A barbarousness, or vitiousness, in speech or utterance; or an impediment therein; (S, Msb, K;) so that one does not speak distinctly. (S.) You say, فِى لِسَانِهِ حُكْلَةٌ [In his speech, or utterance, is a barbarousness, &c.]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
